split_roles.rule: The one-seed developmental screen must never be run on test. Test remains unopened until a frozen validation GO decision authorizes confirmation.

developmental_panel.failure_if_insufficient_pairs: If fewer than 40 valid outcome-blind matched tuples are available at either count, HOLD_PANEL_QUALIFICATION; do not relax matching, topology, token, or feasibility constraints after inspecting model outputs.

matched_tuple_contract.pair_failure_rule: Discard the whole CHAIN/HUB pair if either member fails a predeclared model-independent qualification. Never keep one member alone.

procedure: For each split and count in {3,4}, enumerate candidate base scenes with at least count+1 eligible objects using only frozen dataset metadata.
Canonicalize eligible objects by stable object ID.
Score each eligible object by SHA256(active_object_salt || split_sha256 || base_scene_id || count || object_id); choose the count+1 smallest scores.

Choose a permitted predicate/direction multiset from the frozen candidate library using a deterministic hash of split_sha256, base_scene_id, count and protocol_version; no model output may enter this choice.
Construct both CHAIN and HUB endpoint assignments from the frozen templates over the same selected active objects.
Apply the frozen deterministic role rotation so hub-anchor identity and predicate-to-edge assignment are counterbalanced across tuples.
Textualize both members with the same frozen instruction-template family.
Require exact CLIP token-count equality within the pair and no truncation.
Run only the frozen semantic/geometric feasibility checker on both members; reject the whole pair if either fails.
Score each surviving tuple by SHA256(panel_order_salt || split_sha256 || base_scene_id || count || canonical_pair_payload_sha256), sort ascending and select the first 40 per count.
panel_compiler_contract.authority_rule: The frozen executable compiler and its final panel manifest are the sole panel authority. Manual tuple substitution, replacement, or hand-curated exceptions are forbidden after the manifest is sealed.

predicted_oracle_protocol.predicted_arm: instruction -> frozen SGP-14 -> predicted graph -> frozen shared SG2SC
predicted_oracle_protocol.oracle_arm: same instruction/object scaffold -> ground-truth instructed relation graph -> same frozen shared SG2SC
predicted_oracle_protocol.oracle_information_interpretation: Oracle receives correct instructed relations by intervention. It is an upper-bound localization condition, not a deployment baseline or equal-information competitor.

identity_failure_policy.primary_population: Every materialized instruction remains in text-to-graph and end-to-end denominators.
identity_failure_policy.diagnostic: exact_identity_eligible is recorded for every instruction.
identity_failure_policy.localization_block: If the identity eligibility gate fails, block the oracle localization claim rather than selecting a cleaner subset.

observables_and_denominators.stage_warning: The three stage observables are not an exact multiplicative waterfall. A scene may realize a relation absent from the predicted graph. Causal localization comes from the predicted/oracle intervention.

primary_estimand.name: PAIRED_SGP14_PREDICTED_END_TO_END_TOPOLOGY_EFFECT
primary_estimand.definition: Delta_topo = mean_i(iRecall_HUB_i - iRecall_CHAIN_i) over matched base-scene tuples, pooled over counts 3-4.

analysis.cross_count_scene_reuse_rule: If a physical base_scene_id contributes tuples at both count 3 and count 4, all observations from that scene are resampled together in one bootstrap cluster across counts.

meaningful_topology_residual.requirement: abs(pooled predicted Delta_topo) >= 0.10 AND its 95% base-scene bootstrap CI excludes zero

cross_count_consistency.requirement: count-3 and count-4 predicted Delta_topo have the same sign AND abs(effect) >= 0.05 at each count

upstream_correspondence.requirement: pooled text-to-graph topology effect has the same sign as pooled predicted end-to-end Delta_topo

oracle_identification.requirement: exact_identity_eligible >= 0.95 in every count x topology primary cell AND absolute CHAIN-HUB eligibility-rate difference <= 0.05 within each count

forbidden_after_outcomes: adding 5/6 relation counts to rescue novelty
